_comment: Scout findings reviewed and accepted as false positives. An entry covers a finding when: detector matches; the file path ends with `file`; the flagged span text contains `match`, and the source line at the span contains `line`. No line numbers are stored, so entries survive unrelated edits, and a new finding elsewhere is never hidden. Add an entry only with a reviewer-checkable reason.

reviewed.reason: withdraw_from_subaccount: guarded two lines above by `if actual_received > tracked { panic WalletOverWithdraw }` and `actual_received > 0`, so 0 <= result <= tracked. overflow-checks = true in release as a backstop.

Operator-only, not paused; `subaccount` must be admin-whitelisted and of type Wallet; spender and recipient are the vault itself so funds only move into the vault, bounded by the wallet owner's allowance on the vault's own asset and by WalletOverWithdraw.
update_wallet_deployed_batch duplicate scan: i < count <= MAX_SUBACCOUNTS (10), enforced by the early MaxSubaccountsReached return, so i + 1 <= 10. overflow-checks = true as a backstop.
